sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN GOVERNMENT DELEGATION OF POWERS UNDER THE FINANCIAL RULES
AND THE POWERS OF RE-APPROPRIATION RULES, 2008
BALOCHISTAN GOVERNMENT DELEGATION OF POWERS UNDER THE FINANCIAL RULES AND
THE POWERS OF RE-APPROPRIATION RULES, 2008
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 29th November, 2013]
No.FD.SO
(Reg-II)II-24/2013/2195-2295, dated 29-11-2013.---In exercise of the powers
conferred by Article 119 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, 1973, the Governor of Balochistan is pleased to make the following
amendments in the Balochistan Government Delegation of Powers under the
Financial Rules and the Powers of Re-appropriation Rules, 2008, namely:--
In the aforesaid rules,--
(a) in rule
4, in the proviso to the explanation, after the words and comma "High
Court," the words and comma "Chairman Balochistan Service
Tribunal," shall be inserted; and
(b) in the
THIRD SCHEDULE, after Sr. No.24, as amended
on 10-06-2013, the following new Sr. No. shall be
added:--
"25.
BALOCHISTAN SERVICE TRIBUNAL
"25.1 Power to sanction expenditure on any item
from within the allocated budget of the Balochistan Service Tribunal.
1. Chairman,
Balochistan Service Tribunal.
Full Powers
25.2 Power to create
new posts and abolish old posts.
1. Chairman,
Balochistan Service Tribunal.
Full Powers: Provided
that expenditure is met from within the allocated budget of the Balochistan
Service Tribunal.
25.3 Power to change the nomenclature and upgrade /
down-grade any post.
1. Chairman,
Balochistan Service Tribunal.
Full Powers: Provided
that expenditure is met from within the allocated budget of the Balochistan
Service Tribunal.
25.4 Re-appropriation
of funds from one head of account to another head of account.
1. Chairman,
Balochistan Service Tribunal.
Full Powers,
remaining within the allocated budget of the Balochistan Service Tribunal.
Note:- Powers
specified in this part are in addition to and
not is substitution of the powers mentioned in the
SECOND SCHEDULE.
